environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) within a VPC that has NO NAT gateway, NO internet gateway route in the subnet route table, and NO VPC peering connections to internet-routable networks. The only route table entry is local (10.0.0.0/16 -> local). DNS resolution is provided via Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint configured with a private hosted zone that only resolves *.internal.corp.net names. Security group egress rules restrict outbound to CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 on ports 8080 and 443 only. There is a PrivateLink endpoint for ECR (for image pulls) but no other VPC endpoints. The ALB is internal-only (scheme: internal) and receives traffic only from a separate API gateway VPC via PrivateLink interface endpoint with endpoint policy restricting to GET/POST on /api/* paths only.

config.ingress_path: PrivateLink from API GW VPC, endpoint policy: GET|POST /api/*
